We proceed by setting the upper bound equal to some parameter $a,$ integrating as usual, and then taking the limit as $a\to \infty .$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{5}{\sqrt[3]{{y}^{8}}}\,\text{d}y & ={lim}_{a\to \infty }{\int }_{1}^{a}\frac{5}{\sqrt[3]{{y}^{8}}}\,\text{d}y \\  & =5{lim}_{a\to \infty }{\int }_{1}^{a}{y}^{-8/3}\,\text{d}y \\  & =5{lim}_{a\to \infty }{[-\frac{3}{5}{y}^{-5/3}]}_{1}^{a} \\  & =-3\cdot {lim}_{a\to \infty }{[\frac{1}{\sqrt[3]{{y}^{5}}}]}_{1}^{a} \\  & =-3\cdot {lim}_{a\to \infty }(\frac{1}{\sqrt[3]{{a}^{5}}}-\frac{1}{\sqrt[3]{{1}^{5}}}) \\  & =-3(0-1) \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$
